summary: Added v1.32.4 consolidated changelog entry to mcp-server/changelog.md, covering all four groups from the rework plan: Group A (slug validation guards in handleDeleteKnowledge and handlePromoteKnowledge), Group B (scope rejection in handleListKnowledge), Group C (|| undefined → != null fix in api-client.js, projectInsightId → repositoryInsightId rename, getKnowledge JSDoc correction), and Group D (PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX → SLUG_REGEX rename).

The new entry explicitly mentions all three acceptance-criteria items: handler hardening (slug validation in delete/promote + scope rejection in list), the PROJECT_SLUG_REGEX → SLUG_REGEX rename, and the || undefined fix in api-client.js.
The entry follows existing format conventions (## vX.Y.Z heading, bullet-list body, grouped by concern) and is placed at the top of the file above v1.32.3.
Delegated CTX context regeneration — ctx generate ran cleanly (33 documents updated, exit code 0).

comments.note: The v1.32.4 rollup entry coexists with the more granular per-WP entries (v1.32.1, v1.32.2, v1.32.3) added during individual documentation passes. This is intentional — the rollup entry gives consumers a single place to understand the full rework scope, while the individual entries preserve the per-change history. If the convention shifts to a 'rollup-only' model in future, the intermediate entries could be collapsed.

The pre-existing api-client.test.ts regression (5 failures, project_slug vs repository_name field naming mismatch from commit 294687a) is documented in the Known Issue section of v1.32.4 and was already noted in v1.32.3. It remains out of scope for this rework plan and requires a separate follow-up work package.
